{{Quote|The Chancellor's signal is coming from right there. The observation platform at the top of that spire.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=ChancellorsSignal-ROTS.flac|<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
An '''Observation deck''' was a location often found on [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|Space stations]], containing a [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]], where the crew could directly observe the surrounding environment. It could also be referred to as an '''Observation dome''', '''Observation blister''', or '''Observation platform'''. Some stations and larger starships had purpose-built observation decks, but often, smaller spacecraft lacked a dedicated observation deck and utilized the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] for the same function. The observation deck was fundamentally a form of passive [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] collection.

[[File:EmperorsTower-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|200px|Palpatine's tower on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].]]

Notable locations include the [[Emperor's throne room]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] and [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], the surgery suite on board the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], and the [[General's quarters]] atop of the [[Wizard's Tower/Legends|Wizard's Tower]] on board the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].

[[File:Empire_endshot.png|thumb|right|250px|The Rebels standing on an observation deck on board the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']].]]
